scope: All 60 Investee profiles in the existing rows 001-060 database import package.
policy: The existing import package was modified in place; no additional import package was created.
Primary business is stored as sector_primary and use_case_primary.
Secondary business is stored as sector_secondary and use_case_secondary.
Taxonomy uses normalized snake_case values to support downstream merging and grouping.
Classification evidence reuses the exact official website and imported deal/profile sources already attached to each record.
Investee LinkedIn remains outside the current database import contract and is documented as a schema gap.
